author: ThioJoe
description:
I don't know if ANY software is safe anymore.

Recently the official download website for popular software CPU-Z and HWMonitor was compromised, and the official download links were redirected to malware. The malicious files were named to impersonate the software. Both the installer and portable versions were compromised. In this video I talk about how it happened, what the malicious versions looked like, and more.
